{{Game Update}} {{Infobox/Character |shop = Yes |abiphone = Yes |quests = {{Quest|Time to Mine}}
{{Quest|Reforger}} |location = [[Blacksmith (Zone)]] |location_page_description = Allows the player to [[Reforge]] items, after providing {{Item|Coal|amount=10}}. |x = 10.5 |y = 63 |z = -126.5 |location2 = [[Gold Mine]] |location_page_description2 = Allows the player to [[Reforge]] items. |x2 = -39.5 |y2 = 77 |z2 = -299.5 |location3 = [[Dwarven Village]] |location_page_description3 = Allows the player to [[Reforge]] items. |x3 = -6.5 |y3 = 201 |z3 = -154.5 }} The '''Blacksmith''' is an [[NPC]] located in {{Zone|Blacksmith}}, {{Zone|Gold Mine}}, and {{Zone|Dwarven Village}}. They are a service character that will [[Reforge]] your gear for a fee, depending on the [[rarity]] of your gear. == Reforging == {{Main|Reforging}} There is an [[Anvil]] next to the blacksmith, allowing the player to [[Enchantments|Enchant]] their gear using books at the cost of experience levels. == Quest == When first interacting with the '''Blacksmith''', he introduces you to the service he provides and then gives the player a [[Quest]], titled "Time To Mine". This requires the player to mine {{Item|Coal|amount=10}} and reach {{Skill|mining|1}}. After doing so, the [[player]] will unlock the '''Blacksmith''''s menu. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !colspan="2" |Condition !Dialogue |- |colspan="2" class="ct" | First Interaction |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &fI'm the town Blacksmith! I can &areforge &fitems for you, for a price. &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &fReforging usually costs Coins, but since I'm feeling friendly I can reforge your first item for &fCoal &8x10&f. &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &fGo into the Mine to collect Coal, then come back to learn how to reforge items! }} |- |colspan="2" rowspan="2" class="ct" |During the {{Yellow|Mine Coal}} objective |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &fMine some more Coal in the Mine!}} |- |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &fI will teach you how to reforge items once you mine some more Coal!}} |- |colspan="2" class="ct" | Before reaching {{Skl|mining 1}} or finishing the {{Yellow|Mine Coal}} objective |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &fReach &aMining Level I &fto gain access to the &6Gold Mine&f, north of the &8Coal Mine&f. &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &fThe &6Gold Mine &fis more dangerous than the &8Coal Mine&f, but it has better ores and treasures! }} |- |colspan="2" class="ct" | Before visiting the [[Gold Mine]] or finishing the {{Yellow|Mine Coal}} objective |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &fTravel to the &6Gold Mine &fto spelunk for better ores, including iron and gold!}} |- |colspan="2" class="ct" | First Interaction after completing the {{Yellow|Mine Coal}} objective |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &fAhh, excellent! &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &fReforging items allows you to get the most out of your weapons, armor, and other items by applying stat modifiers to them! &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &fTo reforge an item, place an item in my inventory. Reforging costs Coins - the more prestigious items cost more to reforge! &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &fHowever, this time I will reforge any item for the low price of &fCoal &8x10&f! }} |- | class="ct" rowspan="3" | {{Abiphone Contact}} | class="ct" | Intereacting while holding [[Abiphones| Abiphone]]. |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &b✆&f You want my contact? &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &b✆&f Nonono, not happening. &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &b✆&f Well... Actually... &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &b✆&f No, no absolutely not. &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &b✆&f Unless? Hmm, lemme think about it. &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &b✆&f No for sure, for sure. That would be too much. &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &b✆&f But maybe... If you do something for me. &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &b✆&f I owe a lot of money to someone... Someone important. &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &b✆&f Don't ask me how I got into this situation. &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &b✆&f I owe them &632M coins&f. &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &b✆&f If you help me, I'll allow you to use my services from anywhere. &6&l[PAY DEBT] }} |- | class="ct" | Paying {{Gold|Debt}} |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &b✆&f You are a lifesaver. &e[NPC] &6Blacksmith&f: &b✆&f I swear I wont get in that trouble again! &b✆&f &6Blacksmith&f has been added to your Abiphone's contacts! }} |} == Trivia == *Despite the [[NPC]] having identical appearance and usage in the {{zone|Gold Mine}} or the {{zone|Dwarven Village}}, only the one in the [[Hub]] has an [[Abiphone]] contact. **This is because the [[Abiphone]] system requires a single [[NPC]], and there are 3 different '''Blacksmiths'''.https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/681190535955873831/1030966322865115207https://imgur.com/a/pztovtU == Gallery == File:Blacksmith Hub.png|Blacksmith on the [[Hub Island]] File:Blacksmith Gold Mine.png|Blacksmith in the [[Gold Mine]] File:Blacksmith Dwarven Mines.png|Blacksmith in the [[Dwarven Mines]] == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/Jan 30|Moved the '''Blacksmith''' from {{Coords|-28.5|69|-125.5}} to {{coords|10.5|63|-126.5}}, due to the redesign of the [[Hub Island]].}} |beta= {{History|0.1|[[File:Blacksmith.png|26px]] Added '''Blacksmith'''.}} {{History|2019/June 20|Added dialogue before player completes "Collect 10 coal".}} {{History|2019/December 3|Reforging changed from randomizes to every reforge to every other reforge except the existing one.}} {{History|2020/June 7|Added the ability to shift-click items in the interface.}} {{History|0.9.8|Revamped Blacksmith's Workspace.}} {{History|0.13|Added [[Abiphones#Contacts|{{Aqua|Abiphone Contact}}]].|Removed ability to reforge [[Accessory Bag]] or [[Accessories]].}} {{History|0.24.2|Moved the '''Blacksmith''' from {{Coords|-28.5|69|-125.5}} to {{coords|10.5|63|-126.5}}, due to the redesign of the [[Hub Island]].}} {{History|0.27.2|Added [[Reforge]] guide to the '''Blacksmith'''.}} }} == References == {{Reflist}} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}} [[Category:Reforging]] [[Category:Non-player characters]] [[Category:Quest giver]]

source_pages.raw_wikitext:
* '''{{Coordinates|-68|66|-43}}''': A {{Item|Bell|link=}} is hidden on the bottom of an ice platform near the entrance to the {{Blue|Icy}} biome. Jumping on the platform repeatedly will cause it to flip over, yielding the ''{{Ach|What the flip?!}}'' secret achievement. The bell will be too cold to ring, requiring an {{Item|Icebreaker}} to break it.
* '''{{Coordinates|-96|46|-57}}''': A {{Item|Bell|link=}} is hidden behind a bed found in an underground cavern in the underwater lake in the {{Blue|Icy}} biome.
* '''{{Coordinates|-4|96|-42}}''': A {{Item|Bell|link=}} is hidden on the roof of the mansion in the {{Purple|Haunted}} biome. It can be accessed from parkour from the bottom of the mansion, or from climbing to the top of the {{Blue|Icy}} biome and jumping into the roof.
* '''{{Coordinates|47|55|-7}}''': A {{Item|Bell|link=}} is hidden at the edge of the '''Critter Safari''', accessed from the {{DarkGreen|Forest}} biome waterfalls, before dropping down and walking towards the {{Purple|Haunted}} biome while on the outer rim of the '''Critter Safari'''. The ledge can be exited safely by ascending from the vine at {{Coordinates|16|53|79}}.
* '''{{Coordinates|-30|125|59}}''': A {{Item|Bell|link=}} is hidden near the top of the {{DarkGreen|Forest}} biome, requiring parkour across a large tree to a floating island.
* '''{{Coordinates|-90|109|16}}''': A {{Item|Bell|link=}} is hidden at the top of the {{Gold|Cavern}} biome: you will need to climb from a fake cactus onto a large stack from {{coords|-138|102|26}}, parkour across a tree, and make it to another stack where the bell is found.
* '''{{Coordinates|-50|81|0}}''': A {{Item|Bell|link=}} is hidden at the top of the landing zone, accessible from an ice spike by the entrance to the {{Blue|Icy}} biome.

Each bell corresponds to a specific color in the rainbow. Completing the rainbow and returning to the landing zone yields the following dialogue from {{NPCSprite|"Hunter" Tobias}}:
{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &6"Hunter" Tobias&f: Uh guys, you better come and see this...}}

Finally, a cutscene plays as the player walks into the landing zone. As the player looks at the rainbow, the following dialogue plays:
<center>{{Rmt|&fWow, a &cr&6a&ei&an&ab&9o&5w&f. I haven't seen one of them in a long time. Isn't it beautiful?/&fYou know, there are so many memories in a &cr&6a&ei&an&ab&9o&5w&f./&fI remember seeing one while playing with all my friends, back when we were very small./&fThe next time I saw one was many years later, after one of them died./&fSometimes it feels like, every time I see one, there are less of my kind left to see it with me./&fBut it's still oddly comforting./&fBefore I was here, there were &cr&6a&ei&an&ab&9o&5w&ds&f./&fAfter I am gone, there will still be &cr&6a&ei&an&ab&9o&5w&ds&f./&fThroughout my short life, everything I once knew has changed beyond recognition./&fAs for the &cr&6a&ei&an&ab&9o&5w&ds&f, I don't think they notice the difference.}}</center>

With each dialogue, the player's {{Attr|Miracle Chance}} attribute gains {{Green|+1}} level, maxing out upon the cutscene ending. Players also receive ''{{ach|The Miracle in a sunbeam}}'' secret achievement.

During this cutscene, a custom [[Hypixel SkyBlock OST|song]] plays:

[[File:Safari Rainbug.ogg]]

'''Kiara''' is an [[NPC]] found in the {{zone|North Reaches}}. They teach the player about Reptile and Amphibian [[Shards]]. They also sell {{Item|Viper Shard}}s, {{Item|Crocodile Shard}}s, {{Item|Eel Shard}}s, and {{Item|Gecko Shard}}s.

== UI ==
{{/UI}}

== Abiphone Contact ==
'''Kiara's''' [[Abiphone]] contact can be obtained by giving them a {{Item|Chameleon Shard}}. Obtaining their contact increases the daily stock of their shop by {{Green|+1}}.

== Dialogue ==

== Trivia ==
*{{NPCSprite|Diaz}}'s Shopping Spree perk does not apply to '''Kiara'''{{'}}s shop.
*It costs {{Coins|66.4m}} and {{Green|7}}, {{Green|8}}, {{Green|8}} and {{Green|12}} days to upgrade each [[Attribute]] sold to level {{Green|X}}.
**This can be reduced to  {{Green|6}}, {{Green|7}}, {{Green|7}} and {{Green|10}} days with '''Kiara'''{{'}}s [[Abiphones|Abiphone Contact]].
** This can be reduced up to {{Coins|64.408m}} with {{Item|Seal of the Family}} accessory line.
